spec_gaps.description: INV-TOOL-2's own wording ('No tool writes to disk unless...an explicit opt-in') is generic to every mutating tool; A-002 names both java_rename and java_apply_code_action as the tools it governs. But feat-prove-rename's own behavior/falsifier scope its sweep to java_rename only ('a rename call with no apply argument'), and the only other candidate prove feature -- feat-prove-code-actions -- scopes itself to INV-CA-1/INV-CA-2 (stale/cross-wired handles) instead; its falsifier never mentions apply or disk writes. So INV-TOOL-2's opt-in-to-write guarantee for java_apply_code_action has no owning prove feature yet. This plan follows feat-prove-rename's own scope (rename only) rather than assuming coverage for a sibling tool no feature currently claims.
